handleNewBooking.ts ~1000: non-atomic push into shared teamDestinationCalendars inside concurrent async map; organizer-first ordering is assumed without verification for dynamic collective links, possibly placing wrong calendar as main host

[]` removes the null guard; when destinationCalendar is null/undefined/[] (common case), `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` throws TypeError, causing booking creation 500s for Cal-Video bookings without a destination calendar

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:~1085 — `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` silently drops team destination calendars when destinationCalendar is null (neither eventType nor organizerUser has one), so collective bookings where only team members have destination calendars create no calendar event

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:~1030 — `user.destinationCalendar` may not be included in the prisma select for the dynamic path's userSelect; if absent, teamDestinationCalendars is always empty and the feature is a silent no-op for dynamic collective bookings (confidence 50)

packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:~255 (updateEvent) — When externalCalendarId is undefined (legacy bookings), `event.destinationCalendar?.find(...)` finds nothing and `calendar.events.update({ calendarId: undefined })` sends an invalid request to Google, breaking reschedule/update of legacy bookings

packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:~315 (deleteEvent) — Same self-referential find pattern: when externalCalendarId is undefined, the fallback to the booking's actual destination calendar is lost and calendarId defaults to "primary", so cancellations may delete from the wrong calendar leaving orphaned events

apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts:107 / webhook.ts / paypal-webhook.ts — `booking.destinationCalendar || user.destinationCalendar` assumes surrounding prisma queries select destinationCalendar; the user relation select is risky — if missing, user.destinationCalendar is undefined and reminders target "primary" instead of the actual destination calendar (confidence 50)
